string-array.name: help_oil_temp
string-array.item: Engine oil temperature. Oil warms up much more slowly than coolant.
Usually 90–110 °C on a warm engine, higher in hot weather and under load. While the oil is cold, keep the revs down.
If on your usual route the oil runs noticeably hotter than it used to, check the oil level and the cooling.

string-array.name: help_oil_pressure
string-array.item: Rises with rpm, lower with hot oil. The old rule of thumb is about 70 kPa for every 1000 rpm.
If the oil pressure light comes on, shut the engine off right away.

string-array.name: help_oil_life
string-array.item: Remaining oil life. It\'s not a sensor: the ECU works it out from how the engine has been run, rpm and temperature.
Reset to 100 % at an oil change, then counts down. Should match what the cluster shows.
If nobody reset it at the last change, the number means nothing; go by mileage.
